purpose: Freeze predictions before an actual WFT3 FEM result exists. This tests out-of-support predictions, not validated optimization.

predictions.meaning: Single wavelength/direction/polarization absorptivity; directional emissivity under reciprocity and thermal-equilibrium assumptions.
limitations: Not a band-integrated or cone-integrated result.
Eight training geometries; changed bottom width unsupported.
No clipping of unphysical predictions. GP uncertainty and ray sampling error do not measure model discrepancy.
Normal-angle wave effects and unreviewed training labels remain limitations.
